outcome_definition.diagnostic: sorted set of refusal reasons (and the status of execution_unreconciled); not part of the signature. interop-v0.1 records, for readers, the reason of the refusal 6 of its cases are about (checked as a subset); no corpus makes reasons normative

outcome_definition.outcome: verdict signature of VERIFIER.md section 4: verdict, sorted set of refusal codes, sorted set of finding codes
outcome_definition.silent: no outcome differs, but at least one refusal reason moved (corpus-adequacy's silent class): the corpora cannot see the fault in their pinned outcomes
